- **Page and library:** one 800×800 canvas centred on the `#05070f` background. The only external file is dat.gui 0.7.9, loaded from the cdnjs CDN, so the page needs an internet connection for the control panel to appear. The dat.gui panel is restyled in the `#ffd400` accent colour.

- Use one 800×800 <canvas> centered on a dark background.
- Allowed external library: dat.gui for parameter controls.
- No other external libraries, frameworks, modules, or assets.

  - branch split chance

  - synapse glow strength

  - pulse frequency
  - pulse brightness
  - background color
  - branch color

{"path":"neuron_growth_anthropic-claude-opus-5-5_01.html","edit_description":"Create a single self-contained HTML file: neon neuron growth simulation. Only external: dat.gui from CDN (https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dat-gui/0.7.9/dat.gui.min.js). One 800x800 canvas centered on body background #05070f, flex centering. Style dat.gui accent with #ffd400 (title bars, sliders fg). No mention of any game/movie/brand.

Palette: bg #05070f, bg glow #101a3a, branch #00e5ff, accent #d6ff00, synapse #ff2bd6, pulse #fff36a, UI #ffd400, scanline rgba(0,229,255,0.08).

JS sections with short comments: SETUP, GUI SETUP, NEURON GROWTH, SYNAPSE DETECTION, PULSE ANIMATION, RENDERING, LOOP.

params: neuronCount 4 (3-6 step1), growthSpeed 1.5 (0.2-5), maxDepth 5 (1-8 step1), splitChance 0.04 (0-0.2), curvature 0.25 (0-1), maxLength 90 (20-200), synapseDistance 14 (4-40), synapseGlow 18 (0-40), pulseSpeed 0.02 (0.005-0.08), pulseFrequency 0.08 (0-0.5, chance per frame to spawn), pulseBrightness 1 (0.2-2), bgColor, branchColor, accentColor, synapseColor, pulseColor (addColor). Buttons: regenerate(), clear() (empties network and pulses, stops growth), togglePause() label 'pause / resume'. Folders Growth, Synapses, Pulses, Visuals, open.

Data: neurons [{x,y,id}], branches [{id, neuron, parent, depth, pts:[{x,y}], angle, len, maxLen, width, speed, accent bool, alive, curveDir}], synapses [{a,b (branch ids), x,y, phase, na, nb neuron ids}], synKeys Set of 'min-max' branch id pairs, pulses [{path: array of points, t, speed}]. MAX_BRANCHES=400.

Setup: regenerate() places neuronCount neurons within 90px of center, each spawns 5-8 root branches radially at random angles depth 0.

Growth each frame (if not paused and growing): for each alive branch, advance by growthSpeed*speed: angle += (Math.random()-0.5)*curvature*0.6 + curveDir*curvature*0.02; add point every ~4px step (accumulate). stop when len>=maxLen*(1-depth*0.12) or outside canvas margin. On chance splitChance and depth<maxDepth and branches.length<MAX, spawn child branch from tip, angle ±(0.3-0.9) rad, maxLen*0.6-0.8, width*0.75, accent = Math.random()<0.25. When a branch ends and depth<maxDepth, spawn 1-2 children with probability 0.7. Growing=false when no alive branches -> stable.

Synapse detection: each frame for alive branch tips, compare against tips/last points of branches of different neuron (and also points of other branches sampled every 3rd point, lightweight) within synapseDistance; key dedupe; create synapse at midpoint. Cap synapses 150.

Pulses: build path for a synapse: from neuron A origin along branch chain: gather the branch a's ancestry points (root to point nearest synapse) reversed so it goes neuron->synapse, then synapse->neuron B via branch b's ancestry. Simpler: function chainPoints(branchId) returns concatenated pts from root to that branch's tip following parents (child starts at parent's tip region; fine). Path = chainPoints(a) + reverse(chainPoints(b)). Spawn pulse with probability pulseFrequency per frame on random synapse (also during growth). If no synapses, spawn pulse along random branch chain from root outward. Pulse t advances by pulseSpeed * (8/ sqrt(pathlen)) scaled by path length for constant speed: store cumulative lengths, t in px, speed = pulseSpeed*300 px/sec-ish per frame. Interpolate position; draw spark: small bright head with shadowBlur, trail of 6 fading segments behind, plus tiny random jitter lines (electric). When pulse passes synapse, flash synapse (set flash=1 decays). Max 40 pulses.

Rendering: clear with bgColor; radial gradient glow bgGlow #101a3a at center; faint grid lines every 40px rgba(0,229,255,0.04). Branches: for each branch draw path with quadratic curves via midpoints, lineWidth width, strokeStyle branch or accent color, shadowBlur 8, globalAlpha 0.85, lighter composite. Neuron somas: glowing circles radius 4-6. Synapses: radius 2.5+sin(phase)*1 plus flash, shadowBlur synapseGlow*(1+flash), fill synapseColor, plus outer ring. Pulses. Then overlay: scanlines every 3px rgba(0,229,255,0.08) at low alpha with slow scroll offset; random noise: 250 random 1px dots low alpha per frame; vignette radial gradient transparent to rgba(0,0,0,0.75). Small HUD text top-left in #ffd400 monospace: 'NEURONS n  BRANCHES n  SYNAPSES n  STATE GROWING/STABLE/PAUSED'.

Loop requestAnimationFrame; paused stops updates but keeps drawing. Keep compact (~300 lines)."}
